content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: This AfternoonMostly sunny, with a high near 82. Southwest wind 11 to 14 mph, with gusts as high as 23 mph. TonightA chance of showers after 5am. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 51. Southwest wind 11 to 14 mph, with gusts as high as 23 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%.FridayRain. Temperature rising to near 64 by 9am, then falling to around 51 during the remainder of the day. North wind around 11 mph, with gusts as high as 21 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible. Friday NightRain, mainly before 8pm. Low around 32. Northwest wind 5 to 14 mph, with gusts as high as 24 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New precipitation amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible. SaturdaySunny, with a high near 49. Northwest wind 9 to 13 mph, with gusts as high as 23 mph. Saturday NightMostly clear, with a low around 30.SundaySunny, with a high near 59.Sunday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 43.MondayPartly sunny, with a high near 66.Monday NightA chance of rain between 8pm and 2am. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 52. Chance of precipitation is 30%.TuesdayA chance of rain. Partly sunny, with a high near 73. Chance of precipitation is 40%.Tuesday NightA chance of rain. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 55. Chance of precipitation is 40%.WednesdayA chance of rain. Partly sunny, with a high near 78. Chance of precipitation is 30%.
